title: Register and report greenhouse emissions and energy above the NGER thresholds
what: A controlling corporation whose group's emissions or energy production or use meets an NGER threshold must register with the Clean Energy Regulator and report each year.

laws.title: National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting Act 2007

sources.title: National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting Act 2007
sources.quote: (1) A controlling corporation must apply, in accordance with this section, to be registered under Division 3 if the corporation’s group meets one or more of the thresholds under section 13 for a financial year (the trigger year) ending on or after 30 June 2009.

triggers.unit: tonnes CO2-e of scope 1 and 2 emissions a year (corporate group)
triggers.note: Energy thresholds (200 terajoules for a group) also apply (s 13).

sources.title: National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting Act 2007
sources.quote: (iii) if the year is a later financial year—50 kilotonnes or more;

reach.condition: if its corporate group meets an NGER threshold (such as 50 kilotonnes of emissions a year)
